Package com.kerosene.kfe.adapters.out.rail.provider

Class ExternalRailProviderRegistry

java.lang.Object
com.kerosene.kfe.adapters.out.rail.provider.ExternalRailProviderRegistry
public class ExternalRailProviderRegistry extends Object
Reports the selected external rail implementations and their runtime liveness at application startup. Provider inspection is best-effort so a broken Lightning health probe does not prevent boot.
